description: Parse Falco JSON (message) and normalize key fields to ECS so Sigma rules (product: linux) resolve against logs-falco-*.

script.source: def of = ctx.falco.output_fields; Map proc = ctx.process instanceof Map ? ctx.process : new HashMap(); if (of.containsKey('proc.cmdline')) proc.command_line = of.get('proc.cmdline'); if (of.containsKey('proc.exepath')) proc.executable = of.get('proc.exepath'); else if (of.containsKey('proc.exe')) proc.executable = of.get('proc.exe'); if (of.containsKey('proc.name')) proc.name = of.get('proc.name'); if (of.containsKey('proc.pid')) proc.pid = of.get('proc.pid'); if (of.containsKey('proc.pname')) { Map par = proc.parent instanceof Map ? proc.parent : new HashMap(); par.name = of.get('proc.pname'); proc.parent = par; } if (of.containsKey('proc.cwd')) proc.working_directory = of.get('proc.cwd'); if (!proc.isEmpty()) ctx.process = proc; if (of.containsKey('user.name')) { Map u = ctx.user instanceof Map ? ctx.user : new HashMap(); u.name = of.get('user.name'); ctx.user = u; } if (of.containsKey('container.id')) { Map c = ctx.container instanceof Map ? ctx.container : new HashMap(); c.id = of.get('container.id'); ctx.container = c; } if (of.containsKey('fd.name')) { Map f = ctx.file instanceof Map ? ctx.file : new HashMap(); f.path = of.get('fd.name'); ctx.file = f; } Map ev = ctx.event instanceof Map ? ctx.event : new HashMap(); if (of.containsKey('evt.type')) ev.action = of.get('evt.type'); if (ctx.falco.source == 'syscall') ev.category = ['process']; ev.module = 'falco'; ev.kind = 'event'; ctx.event = ev;
